title: Напоминаем и предупреждаем
description: Напоминаем и предупреждаем: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
notes: Remind me to call — напомни выполнить действие.
Warn someone not to do — предупредить не делать; not ставится перед to.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The supervisor warned us ___ the wet floor.
exercises.explanation: Warned us not to cross правильно передаёт отрицательное предупреждение.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: to / for.

public_payload.sentence: Please remind me ___ lock the cupboard.

exercises.editorial_answer: Please remind me to lock the cupboard.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Она напомнила нам вернуть ключи.»
exercises.editorial_answer: She reminded us to return the keys.
exercises.explanation: Reminded us to return называет адресата и требуемое действие.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: He warned me not touch the loose cable.

accepted: He warned me not to touch the loose cable.

exercises.reference_answer: He warned me not to touch the loose cable.
exercises.incorrect_answer: He warned me not touch the loose cable.
exercises.editorial_answer: He warned me not to touch the loose cable.
exercises.explanation: После not в этой конструкции нужен to перед touch.

public_payload.passage: Before the workshop, the supervisor warned everyone not to cross the newly cleaned floor. She put up a sign and showed an alternative route. Later, she reminded the volunteers to return the room keys before leaving. The first message concerned a current hazard, while the second helped people remember a routine task. Neither message meant that the task had already been completed.

options.label: Not crossing the newly cleaned floor.
Returning keys that had already been lost.

exercises.editorial_answer: Not crossing the newly cleaned floor.
exercises.explanation: Первое предупреждение связано с состоянием пола.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: remind — напоминать; warn — предупреждать; hazard — опасный фактор; notice — уведомление
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: remind — напоминать; warn — предупреждать; hazard — опасный фактор; notice — уведомление.

exercises.prompt: Что важно о напоминании вернуть ключи?

public_payload.passage: Before the workshop, the supervisor warned everyone not to cross the newly cleaned floor. She put up a sign and showed an alternative route. Later, she reminded the volunteers to return the room keys before leaving. The first message concerned a current hazard, while the second helped people remember a routine task. Neither message meant that the task had already been completed.

options.label: It confirms that every key is in the cupboard.
It means returning keys is forbidden.
It does not prove that the keys have already been returned.

exercises.editorial_answer: It does not prove that the keys have already been returned.
exercises.explanation: Напоминание о будущем действии не устанавливает факт исполнения.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: I often forget to send the attendance list.

options.label: Ask a colleague to remind you to send it.
Ask a colleague to remind you sending to it.
Ask a colleague remind to you send it.

exercises.editorial_answer: Ask a colleague to remind you to send it.
exercises.explanation: Remind you to send сохраняет нужную модель.
